missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Фильм' is masculine and stays in the nominative as the predicate. 'Интересный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, intensified by 'очень'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Фильм' is inanimate masculine, so its accusative matches the nominative as the object of 'смотрели'. 'Новый' agrees in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Фильма' is genitive marking whose ending it is. 'Конца' is the accusative object of 'не понял'.
Strategic focus: Dative object. 'Фильму' is dative after 'подходит', which governs that case to express suitability.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Фильме' is prepositional after 'о', marking the topic of conversation.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Фильмом' is instrumental after 'восхищались', which governs that case. 'Этим' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Фильмы' is the nominative plural subject of 'идут'. 'Новые' is the agreeing plural adjective.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural. 'Фильмов' is genitive plural after 'много', counting an indefinite number.
Strategic focus: Accusative plural. 'Фильмы' is the accusative plural object of 'любим'; inanimate, so it matches the nominative plural. 'Старые французские' agree in the plural.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject in a question. 'Фильм' is nominative as the subject of 'понравился'. 'Какой' agrees in the masculine nominative, and 'тебе' is the dative experiencer.
